Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: finished transparent game title artwork for an existing fantasy tavern slot machine. Primary request: exquisitely art-directed dimensional lettering reading exactly "The Fox’s Fortune". Single wide horizontal title, with a small elegant "The" tucked above the left of the main line "Fox’s Fortune". Beautiful bespoke vintage storybook serif letterforms, warm luminous ivory faces, sculpted antique-gold beveled edges, deep walnut dimensional shadows, restrained emerald enamel accents and small gold leaf flourishes extending from the ends. Superb hand-painted AAA fantasy board-game quality. The composition is graceful and legible, not an ornate rectangular plaque. Typography is the hero; no fox illustration or crown because the cabinet immediately below already has a crowned fox. The existing game world is carved walnut, aged brass and emerald leather lit by amber on the left and a faint teal rim on the right. Transparent background, isolated complete silhouette, generous clear safety margin, wide 3:1 composition. No background scene, no rectangle, no tagline, no extra text, no watermark. Exact text: "The Fox’s Fortune".
